decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (AL_FEB17_48ST_00 received: 31/01/2018. Householder Flood Risk Matrix received: 14/02/2018. AL_FEB17_48ST_01 Rev J and AL_FEB17_48ST_02 Rev J received: 26/04/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a side and rear roof extension with juliette balcony and two front roof windows.  Erection of a single storey side and rear extension with conversion of garage into a habitable room of the house
